notes: Ludwig validation mode replicates the search strategy from Ludwig et al. (2018) Lancet Psychiatry (trauma/stressors in FND). Uses a 3-block AND query: FND terms x stressor terms x study-design terms. Date range: inception to 2016/11/04. Language filters are NOT applied at search stage.
